reviewMethod: Root independently actually read every complete selected POS, Chinese meaning, original English sentence and complete Chinese translation of all 195 locked rows, alongside all displayed full source Chinese meanings, all variants and all lexical glosses, in eight untruncated bounded views: rows 1-25,26-50,51-75,76-100,101-125,126-150,151-175,176-195. Root did not author these pairs. Root also read the complete five individual authoring deferrals and author notes. Genuine selected common-noun uses North/Maxim/Utopia/Communion occur sentence-initially, not as unsupported proper identities. Named place/person/religion/calendar/entity branches use 87 root-reviewed exact-source POS pins, not blanket noun promotion. GDP is the frozen chemical, not WordNet's economic GDP; F is farad, not a letter/fluorine/Fahrenheit. Proper identities, countries versus languages, named titles, register and older Moslem spelling are separately selected. No endorsement of unselected dated WordNet geopolitical, population, religious, clinical or formula claims. English grammar, natural usage, source-sense match, target realization and Chinese fidelity were judged for every retained row. No known substantive blocking error found in these 195 selected-sense examples; this is independent AI review, not human certification or exhaustive-sense coverage. Final source and raw lock hashes are pinned above. Nothing is published by this decision.
